name: sol7-compact-selectors
goal: Compact selectors paint only their display label and short hash at every viewport

evidence: New tip and at-tip states show native option text over the display label. HarnessSelectors uses canonical Select; constrain the compact host style without changing its controls.
Existing catalog tested selectors only without tip. New tip and at-tip states exercise the unchanged closed-field transparency assertion at desktop tablet and mobile.
